courses.note: A Georgetown Introduction to Algorithms course site (prerequisite given as COSC-2010 or COSC-160, so it mixes old and new numbering; the page does not state COSC 3200). The page prints no term, so the term is inferred: the first class is 8/28 on an MW schedule (a Wednesday in 2024, a Thursday in 2025) and the server's Last-Modified header is 14 Dec 2024, the date of the final exam listed (12/14). Fall 2024 is therefore the best-supported term; the same URL has not been updated for 2025-26 and no newer algorithms syllabus was found.

courses.note: The BS requirements list neither a software engineering course nor a capstone. The BS required courses are COSC 1020, 1030, 1110, 2010, 2020 (Advanced Programming), 2310, 3010, 3020, 3200 plus electives; a senior thesis is optional. A project-based Senior Capstone is required only in the separate CSES (Computer Science, Ethics and Society) major variant, not the BS.

notes: Georgetown University (Washington, DC), not Georgetown College (KY). Catalog uses 4-digit COSC numbers (1020, 1030, 2010, 3200) while public course sites still use the old numbers (051, 052, 160, 240). The newest public pages were found at the instructor level (people.cs.georgetown.edu, personal course sites); the static.scs.georgetown.edu syllabus host did not resolve during collection. A Fall 2026 COSC 2010 Data Structures site (Maloof) contains a strong AI prohibition, but COSC 2010 is not one of the four frame slots, so it was not collected under a slot. The department's honor-policy page (cs.georgetown.edu/honor/) is department-level and was not collected here.
